# nvidia/x

Hand-written packages built on the generated NVIDIA bindings.

This inventory describes the source tree that generated it, not installed
CUDA libraries or hardware support. Regenerate before relying on it.
From the nvidia module, run `go run ./internal/cmd/xinventory`; use
`-root` to select another package directory, or `-check` to check for drift.

| Package | Package documentation |
| --- | --- |
